bodyHtml:
Aquasky's Pressure Tank is certified by NSF International. 

National Sanitation Foundation (NSF International) is the world leader of public health standards certification programs that help protect the world's food, water consumer products, and environments.

Aquasky has been a member of NSF since 1998. Every pressure tank we build is qualified by NSF drinking water standards and structure safety (NSF 58 and NSF 61). With NSF standard, Aquasky pressure is lead-free, Nitrosamine free and Plasticizer free. About safety, the Aquasky pressure tank is built to contain 3 times maximum working pressure to ensure user safety. 

NSF has a demanding rule of the audition process. NSF auditor shows up at our door every year without any notice, so the audition cannot be prepared. NSF auditor checks every detail including the coming material, and the production, the supplier chain, and the packaging. At the end of the audition, the auditor randomly selects samples from our inventory sending them to the NSF lab to test the water quality and pressure safety. Every detail must match with listing documents to ensure every Aquasky tank is the same as the testing sample. 

Aquasky is proud to having NSF on our certification list.
